verdict.rationale: Splitting a sale across payment methods or payers is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents split tenders, partial payments, or multiple payers on one sale. Accepting many payment methods, tipping and refunds are related features but do not show a single sale being split.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can split a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers
